$comment: SAM9X75-RDK round panel bring-up spec. Updated 2026-09-07: panel, touch and camera all verified working on hardware. Values are measured on this board or taken from Microchip's MGS demo source / AN5753. Companion docs: SAM9X75-RDK_MD/round-panel-linux-bringup.md and linux-drivers/README.md

status.note: Clean, full, stable colour bars on glass. INT_ST1 bit 19 (dpi_buff_pld_under) still latches but is cosmetic at this timing.
working: touch GT9271 (by I2C polling - see touch.interrupt_broken)
PIC64 MJPEG camera on the hardware overlay plane

mgs_demo.authority: HIGHEST - Microchip's own working driver for this exact board+panel

an5753.authority: HIGHEST for the Linux procedure + clock rule
an5753.title: Adding Support for a Custom MIPI Display on a SAM9X7 Series MPU under Linux (DS00005753)

mcu_i2c_0x45.aes_note: NO AES challenge-response. That lock exists ONLY in the Raspberry-Pi MCU-bridge .ko variant. Dead end.

measured_semantics.0xAB: backlight PWM, INVERTED: 0x00 = full bright, 0xFF = OFF (verified live). Demo uses 55.
measured_semantics.0xAD_0xAC_0xC0_0xC2: power/enable. Writing 0x00 turns the backlight OFF (verified live).

dsi.eot_packets: OFF (demo EOTP_TX_EN(0)); Linux dw-mipi-dsi enables EOTP_TX by DEFAULT unless MIPI_DSI_MODE_NO_EOT_PACKET
dsi.dcs_note: The MGS demo sends NO DCS at all (no 0x11/0x29). Panel is driven by the 0x45 MCU + DSI video only.
dsi.lane_rate_note: HLINE = htotal * lane_mbps / 400. Measured HLINE 0x687=1671 -> 600 Mbps.

timing.warning: The 330-cycle H front porch is panel-specific. Generic/AI-sourced timings (40/10/40, 120/200/32) are WRONG.

clock_polarity.note: Without it LCDCFG0=0x2 (CLKPOL=0): tolerable at low pixel clocks, wrong at 50 MHz.

clocking.pixel_clock_formula: pixel = GCLK / CLKDIV (LCDC_LCDCFG0); CLKBYP bypasses the divider -> pixel = GCLK
clocking.gclk_max_note: SAM9X7 peripheral table: LCDC instance 25 GCLK max 75 MHz. A 100 MHz request is silently clamped to 75.
clocking.driver_logic: atmel_hlcdc_crtc.c (sam9x75 fixed_clksrc=true): div=DIV_ROUND_UP(sys_clk,mode_rate); if(div<2){div=2; NO CLKBYP -> pixel=sys_clk/2} else if(div_low<2) set CLKBYP -> pixel=sys_clk

an5753_rule.quote: The pixel clock expected by the panel is 50 MHz. However, because of potential hardware limitations, experts recommend to program a slightly higher clock frequency, 60 MHz for example. In such case, the assigned clock rate is <60000000>.
an5753_rule.meaning: GCLK must run slightly ABOVE the panel pixel clock. That headroom keeps the DSI DPI buffer fed.
an5753_rule.failure_if_ignored: GCLK == mode clock drops into the /2 path AND starves the DPI buffer -> INT_ST1 bit19 dpi_buff_pld_under -> BLACK SCREEN

debug_registers.clk_tree: mount -t debugfs none /sys/kernel/debug; grep lcd_gclk /sys/kernel/debug/clk/clk_summary (rates are READ-ONLY)

debug_playbook.serial: Workshop/serialcmd.ps1 -PerCmdMs <ms> drives COM5 from Workshop/rdk-cmds.txt -> Workshop/rdk-shell.log. Keep command lines SHORT (long lines overrun the input buffer).
debug_playbook.hold_pattern_indefinitely: Make `modetest -M atmel-hlcdc -s 49@47:720x720` the LAST line of rdk-cmds.txt (nothing after) so it keeps waiting for Enter after the port closes.
debug_playbook.measure_real_refresh: modetest ... -v prints `freq:` = the ACTUAL refresh; the mode's nominal value can lie.
debug_playbook.boot_is_black: The console framebuffer is BLACK at boot - that is NOT a failure. Always judge with modetest.

dead_ends: Reverse-engineering harmony.bin - the only `mov #0x45` in 5.3MB is a PNG parser 'E' tag. MGS source supersedes it.
Generic/AI panel timings (clock-frequency=32000000, 40/10/40 porches) and panel-simple (cannot do the 0x45 MCU init).
Forcing GCLK == mode clock for an 'exact' pixel clock - drops into /2 and starves the DSI.

other_subsystems.ethernet: KSZ9131 @ MDIO addr 7 (NOT LAN8840@1); remove hardcoded ethernet-phy@1 so macb auto-scans
other_subsystems.touch: Goodix GT9271 @ I2C 0x14 on i2c7 (flexcom7 f8014600), IRQ pioC 15 edge-falling
other_subsystems.drm: card0 = microchip-gfx2d (GPU, no output); card1 = atmel-hlcdc
other_subsystems.gst_gotcha: busybox `pkill -f` does NOT match gst-launch-1.0 -> stale gst holds DRM master -> EACCES on later modesets; kill by PID via `fuser /dev/dri/card1`

build_deploy.overlay_only_rebuild: cd ~/SAM9X75-RDK/linux-image/buildroot && ./build.sh overlay   (much faster, no kernel rebuild)
build_deploy.deploy: scp the .itb to the PC, copy onto the SD FAT boot partition (mounts as E: in Windows) - NO reflash needed

mode_in_use.$comment: The mode actually programmed. 'tuned' corrects a ~50 px right-shift of the framebuffer relative to the glass by moving pixels from sync+back porch into the front porch; htotal is unchanged so pixel clock and refresh are identical. Applied from userspace via SETCRTC - no kernel or DT rebuild needed.

interrupt_broken.$comment: /proc/interrupts gt9271 count stays at 1 for ever, so Goodix-TS emits no events even though it probes fine. Worked around by unbinding the driver and polling I2C from userspace.
to_try: confirm the INT pin really is PC15 on the RDK schematic

video_plane.$comment: The XLCDC high-end overlay plane takes I420 natively and scales in hardware: no software convert or scale is needed for an MJPEG stream (~130 ms/frame saved). Only negotiates with kmssink force-modesetting=false on an already configured CRTC.
video_plane.fill_square_panel: render-rectangle larger than the CRTC, e.g. <-120,0,960,720> for a 640x480 feed; DRM clips it, giving an undistorted centre crop that fills 720x720
